text:
liz p (partnerships): Quick handoff for the cross-stack demo sprint with LangChain + gateway partners tomorrow morning. This thread for ops/marketing/legal checklist and any last-minute blockers.
ajay (growth): I'll own the co-announcement copy and marketplace blurb. Need partner logo pack + short quote by EOD.
sam (eng-runtime): Eng will validate the gateway adapter + orchestrator flow today. My plan: run smoke tests on staging, then a dry-run demo.
nina (devex): I'll build the demo script and quickstart. Can someone confirm the sample dataset and environment variables we can include?
marta (legal): Heads up — partners asked for DPA/processing details in the announcement. Send the security blurb and data flow diagrams; I can sign off if they're included.
ajay (growth): Noted. I'll request logo + partner quote now. Also tagging marketing ops to reserve the markdown assets: /cc @mktg-ops (I'll DM them).
sam (eng-runtime): Small blocker: SSO redirect failing in staging (oauth redirect_uri mismatch). Filing with gateway partner now. If not fixed by 13:00 PST, fallback plan is to use API-key demo flow.
nina (devex): API-key fallback is fine for the demo, but we should document the expected SSO behavior in the playbook so partners don't get confused. I'll add a short FAQ.
liz p (partnerships): Also coordinate with hardware partner (they offered test instances). Sam, can you confirm we can run the orchestrator on the GPU instances they promised? Any special kernel/quantization flags we should document?
sam (eng-runtime): Confirmed we can run on the HW partner's instances. Need to enable --quantize=int8 and set batch_size=8 for stable perf. I'll paste the command below and add to quickstart:
```
./deploy_demo.sh --target=partner-gpu --quantize=int8 --batch-size=8
```
ajay (growth): Marketing asks for a one-line CTA for the marketplace tile (20–30 chars). Suggestions: "Low-latency LLM inference stack" or "Plug-and-play orchestration + gateway" — thoughts?
nina (devex): Prefer the 2nd one, shorter is better: "Orchestrator + gateway demo".
marta (legal): For the joint announcement we need a 1-sentence data processing note. Draft: "Data processed in partner-managed infra; Redwood Inference does not retain customer prompt text beyond inference unless contracted." Please confirm.
liz p (partnerships): That phrasing works — Ajay, incorporate into the blurb. Also we need to confirm telemetry contract: what metrics will partner see from the demo? Sam?
sam (eng-runtime): Telemetry we expose: request count, latency p50/p95, error rate. No raw prompts. We'll provide an example CSV of aggregated metrics.
deploy-bot: Deployment succeeded: demo-staging branch -> staging at 2076543402. Artifacts: demo-image:v1.2.3.
ajay (growth): Perfect. I'll draft the marketplace tile + co-announcement and share a PR by 16:00 local.
nina (devex): I'll push demo script updates and sample dataset (anonymized) by 15:30.
marta (legal): I'll review the assets once Ajay drops them. If anything needs redline, I'll flag before 17:00.
liz p (partnerships): Thanks team. Action items summary:
- Ajay: request logos & partner quote; draft marketplace tile + co-ann PR (by 16:00)
- Sam: fix SSO or enable API-key fallback; upload smoke test logs and quant flags (by 14:00)
- Nina: demo script + quickstart + anonymized dataset (by 15:30)
- Marta: legal sign-off on blurb/assets (by 17:00)
I'll follow up with a short meeting invite for a 30-min dry-run at 08:30 PT tomorrow. Ping here for any blockers. :rocket:
